title: A python manifest version is written only when the versioned_files entry declares the version field
expectation: Python has no automatic native-manifest version write, so the typed versioned_files entry must explicitly select version to stamp project.version. This fixture selects version for acme-insight and declares no such entry for acme-report. The insight minor and default dependency propagation plan both packages at 0.5.3 under the pre-1.0 bump shift. Preparation advances insight's project.version, leaves report's own version at 0.5.2, and still rewrites report's internal dependency to acme-insight>=0.5.3. The contract distinguishes explicit own-version stamping from automatic dependency rewriting.

setupFiles.monochange.toml:
# Release configuration for the Acme analytics workspace.
#
# Only acme-insight declares a versioned_files entry, and its `fields` names
# `version`, which is the only way a python manifest's [project].version gets
# written. acme-report deliberately has no entry.

[package.acme-insight]
path = "packages/insight"
type = "python"

[[package.acme-insight.versioned_files]]
path = "packages/insight/pyproject.toml"
type = "python"
fields = ["version"]

[package.acme-report]
path = "packages/report"
type = "python"

[ecosystems.python]
enabled = true
setupFiles..changeset/insight-minor.md:
---
acme-insight: minor
---

Add rolling window aggregation to the insight sampler.

setupCommands: git commit -S -m "chore: initial import of the Acme analytics workspace"

checks.command: monochange preview --format json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import sys,json; p=json.load(sys.stdin); t={x['id']:x['version'] for x in p['release_targets']}; assert t=={'acme-insight':'0.5.3','acme-report':'0.5.3'}, t; print('plan moves both packages to 0.5.3')"
checks.why: The minor on insight plans 0.5.3 (pre-1.0 shift) and default propagation pulls report into the release, so report's manifest is in scope for writes even though it has no changeset.
The contract is about what a real release writes, so the preparation must actually run rather than be previewed.

checks.command: python3 -c "import tomllib,pathlib; m=tomllib.loads(pathlib.Path('packages/insight/pyproject.toml').read_text()); assert m['project']['version']=='0.5.3', m['project']['version']; print('insight [project].version advanced')"
checks.why: The typed entry with `fields = ["version"]` is the positive half: this manifest's version must be written.

checks.command: python3 -c "import tomllib,pathlib; m=tomllib.loads(pathlib.Path('packages/report/pyproject.toml').read_text()); assert m['project']['version']=='0.5.2', m['project']['version']; print('report [project].version stays stale')"
checks.why: Without an entry selecting its version field, report's own project.version remains unchanged even though dependency propagation includes report in the release plan.

checks.command: python3 -c "import tomllib,pathlib; m=tomllib.loads(pathlib.Path('packages/report/pyproject.toml').read_text()); deps=m['project']['dependencies']; assert 'acme-insight>=0.5.3' in deps, deps; print('dependency constraint advanced')"
checks.why: Proves `prepare` ran and reached report's manifest: only the version write was skipped, the internal dependency constraint still moved to the released version.
